commit_message:
domain_sale_status: rank listed prices by frequency instead of taking the first

The first dollar amount on a marketplace page is often a fee or another
listing (HugeDomains showed $100 for a $2,395 name). Return the amounts
most repeated first as prices, and price as the first of them, documented
as a hint to confirm by eye.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
